descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo cercando un agente delle frodi per unirsi al nostro Middle Office – Anti-Fraud & Financial Crime Center team. Il candidato di successo avrà eccellenti capacità comunicative e organizzative e un senso acuto di attenzione ai dettagli.

RESPONSABILITÀ

• Efficacemente comunicare con il nostro team di assistenza clienti interno al fine di risolvere le richieste di controversie.

• Le operazioni relative alla controversia di processo nei rispettivi sistemi di schema interno e carta (piastrelle Visa e MasterCard).

• Recensione degli avvisi di monitoraggio delle transazioni della carta per contrassegnare o identificare attività sospette al di fuori del normale modello e attività.

• Indagare e intraprendere azioni immediate su avvisi, notifiche e report per garantire sempre la conformità.

• Risolvere le questioni per conto dei titolari di carte a sostegno del trattamento di risoluzione delle controversie, confrontare le azioni alternative e decidere su un approccio appropriato.

• Risponde alle richieste in relazione alle transazioni.

• Mantenere tutti i record di indagine e i risultati dei casi.

• Sviluppare e mantenere una forte conoscenza del lavoro di tutte le regole e le normative relative allo schema delle carte.

• Esplora nuovi modi che possono aiutare a migliorare le strategie di frode esistenti.

• L'apprendimento continuo e il miglioramento della conoscenza del prodotto e del lavoro.

• Esperienza minima di 3 anni nel reparto operazioni bancarie.

• La conoscenza delle regole e dei regolamenti di controversia Visa e MasterCard è altamente preferito e sarà considerato un bene forte.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, sia scritta che verbale in inglese e francese.

• Competenze organizzative eccezionali e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Forte capacità analitiche.

• Capace di pensare fuori dalla scatola.

• In grado di lavorare in una squadra.

• In grado di gestire lo stress e lavorare con volumi elevati.

SQ1
Si prega di notare che Swissquote non richiede mai informazioni personali sensibili o il pagamento di alcun tipo durante il processo di reclutamento. Qualsiasi tale richiesta è fraudolenta.
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a Fraud Officer to join our Middle Office – Anti-Fraud & Financial Crime Center team. The successful candidate will have excellent communication and organizational skills and an acute sense of attention to detail.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Effectively communicate with our internal customer support team in order to resolve dispute requests.

• Process dispute related transactions in the respective internal and card scheme systems (Visa and MasterCard platforms).

• Review of card transaction monitoring alerts to flag or identify suspicious activity outside the normal pattern and activity.

• Investigate and take immediate action on alerts, notifications and reporting to always ensure compliance.

• Resolve issues on behalf of card holders in support of dispute resolution processing, compare alternative actions and decide on appropriate approach.

• Respond to requests in relation to transactions.

• Maintain all investigation records and case outcomes.

• Develop and maintain strong working knowledge of all relevant card scheme rules and regulations.

• Explore new ways that can help improve existing fraud strategies.

• Continuously learning and improving on product and job knowledge.

• Minimum of 3 years’ experience in banking operations department.

• Knowledge of Visa and MasterCard dispute rules and regulations is highly preferred and will be considered a strong asset.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal in English and French.

• Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Strong analytical abilities.

• Capability to think out of the box.

• Able to work within a team.

• Able to manage stress and work with high volumes.

SQ1
Please note that Swissquote never requests sensitive personal information or payment of any kind during the recruitment process. Any such request is fraudulent.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Wir suchen einen Fraud Officer, der unserem Team des Middle Office – Anti-Fraud & Financial Crime Center beitritt. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat verfügt über hervorragende kommunikative und organisatorische Fähigkeiten und ein ausgeprägtes Gefühl der Aufmerksamkeit für das Detail.

VERANTWORTUNGEN

• Kommunizieren Sie effektiv mit unserem internen Kundensupport-Team, um Streitanfragen zu lösen.

• Bearbeitung von strittigen Transaktionen in den jeweiligen internen Systemen und Kartensystemen (Visa- und MasterCard-Plattformen).

• Überprüfung von Warnungen zur Überwachung von Kartentransaktionen, um verdächtige Aktivitäten außerhalb des normalen Musters und der normalen Aktivität zu kennzeichnen oder zu identifizieren.

• Untersuchen und ergreifen Sie sofortige Maßnahmen in Bezug auf Warnungen, Benachrichtigungen und Berichte, um die Einhaltung der Vorschriften sicherzustellen.

• Lösen Sie Probleme im Namen von Karteninhabern zur Unterstützung der Streitbeilegung, vergleichen Sie alternative Maßnahmen und entscheiden Sie über einen geeigneten Ansatz.

• Beantworten Sie Anfragen in Bezug auf Transaktionen.

• Führen Sie alle Untersuchungsaufzeichnungen und Fallergebnisse.

• Entwickeln und pflegen Sie fundierte Kenntnisse über alle relevanten Regeln und Vorschriften des Kartenschemas.

• Entdecken Sie neue Wege, die dazu beitragen können, bestehende Betrugsstrategien zu verbessern.

• Kontinuierliches Lernen und Verbessern von Produkt- und Jobwissen.

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Bankbetriebsabteilung.

• Die Kenntnis der Visa- und MasterCard-Streitigkeitsregeln und -vorschriften ist sehr bevorzugt und wird als starker Vermögenswert angesehen.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich in Englisch und Französisch.

• Außergewöhnliche organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Liebe zum Detail.

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, out of the box zu denken.

• Kann in einem Team arbeiten.

• Kann Stress bewältigen und mit hohen Volumina arbeiten.

SQ1
Bitte beachten Sie, dass Swissquote während des Rekrutierungsprozesses niemals sensible persönliche Daten oder Zahlungen jeglicher Art anfordert. Eine solche Anfrage ist betrügerisch.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un agent de fraude pour rejoindre notre équipe du Centre de lutte contre la fraude et la criminalité financière. La candidate reçue aura d'excellentes compétences en communication et en organisation et un sens aigu du détail.

RESPONSABILITES

• Communiquer efficacement avec notre équipe interne de soutien à la clientèle afin de résoudre les demandes de contestation.

• Traiter les transactions liées aux litiges dans les systèmes internes et les systèmes de cartes respectifs (plates-formes Visa et MasterCard).

• Examen des alertes de surveillance des transactions par carte pour signaler ou identifier les activités suspectes en dehors du modèle et de l'activité normaux.

• Enquêter et prendre des mesures immédiates sur les alertes, les notifications et les rapports afin d'assurer toujours la conformité.

• Régler les questions au nom des détenteurs de cartes à l'appui du règlement des différends, comparer les mesures de rechange et décider de l'approche appropriée.

• Répondre aux demandes relatives aux transactions.

• Tenir à jour tous les dossiers d'enquête et les résultats des dossiers.

• Développer et maintenir une solide connaissance pratique de toutes les règles et réglementations relatives aux systèmes de cartes.

• Explorer de nouvelles façons d'améliorer les stratégies de fraude existantes.

• L'apprentissage continu et l'amélioration des connaissances sur les produits et les emplois.

• Minimum de 3 ans d'expérience dans le service des opérations bancaires.

• La connaissance des règles et des règlements relatifs aux différends relatifs aux cartes Visa et MasterCard est hautement privilégiée et sera considérée comme un atout important.

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais et en français.

• Compétences organisationnelles exceptionnelles et attention aux détails.

• Fortes capacités d'analyse.

• Capacité à penser hors de la boîte.

• Peut travailler au sein d'une équipe.

• Capable de gérer le stress et de travailler avec des volumes élevés.

QS1
Veuillez noter que Swissquote ne demande jamais de renseignements personnels sensibles ou de paiement d'aucune sorte pendant le processus de recrutement. Toute demande de ce type est frauduleuse.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vuoi scoprire una banca interna e vivere un'esperienza di apprendimento unica in Svizzera?

Con l'adesione a noi come apprendista, si sta avviando un viaggio di 3 anni alle varie squadre che fanno Swissquote, il leader della banca online in Svizzera.
Vieni ad esplorare il nostro mondo seguendo un corso di formazione completo e vario. Guidato da un maestro di apprendimento, trascorrerai diverse sessioni da 3 a 6 mesi in diverse squadre (Accounting, Marketing, Sales Support, Logistics, ecc.) per imparare i loro lavori principali e svolgere missioni concrete. Dopo questi tre anni con noi, sarete in grado di orientare verso il lavoro che più avete amato.
Oltre alla nostra formazione pratica, sarete anche in grado di prendere i corsi di cultura specializzati e generali della scuola professionale commerciale.

E non è tutto! Offriamo anche grandi vantaggi, come le offerte pagate a metà prezzo o preferenziali per lo sport (fitness, arrampicata, calcio...).

Con l'adesione a Swisssquote, si integrano più di una società ma un ambiente di lavoro giovane (35 anni di età media), varie (70 nazionalità diverse) e amichevole (senza codice abito richiesto).
Allora vieni a crescere con noi!

• Hai appena finito la tua educazione obbligatoria?

• Parli francese fluentemente?

• Hai una buona base in inglese?

• Non vede l'ora di scoprire il campo bancario?

• Puoi essere dinamico e disposto?
Porti tutte queste qualità insieme? Sentiti libero di applicare online con il tuo file completo:

- CV

- lettera di presentazione

- Bollettino delle note degli ultimi tre anni.

Perché impari Swissquote?

• Formazione bancaria completa e diversificata

• Opportunità di acquisire esperienza professionale in un'azienda innovativa, multiculturale e in espansione

• Condividere e condividere esperienze con la nostra comunità di circa 25 apprendisti con sede in Swissquote
descriptionByLocale.en:
Want to discover an inside bank and experience a unique learning experience in Switzerland?

By joining us as an apprentice, you are embarking on a 3-year trip to the various teams that make Swissquote, the leader of the online bank in Switzerland.
Come and explore our world by following a comprehensive and varied training course. Guided by a learning master, you will spend several sessions from 3 to 6 months in different teams (Accounting, Marketing, Sales Support, Logistics, etc.) to learn their main jobs and carry out concrete missions. After these three years with us, you will be able to orientate towards the job you loved most.
In addition to our practical training, you will also be able to take the specialized and general culture courses of the commercial vocational school.

And that's not all! We also offer great advantages, such as the half-price paid or preferential offers for sport (fitness, climbing, football...).

By joining Swisssquote, you integrate more than one company but a young working environment (35 years of average age), various (70 different nationalities) and friendly (no dress code required).
Then come and grow up with us!

• Did you just finish your compulsory education?

• Do you speak French fluently?

• Do you have a good base in English?

• Are you looking forward to discovering the banking field?

• Can you be dynamic and willing?
Do you bring all these qualities together? Feel free to apply online with your full file:

- CV

- cover letter

- Bulletin of notes for the last three years.

Why do you learn Swissquote?

• Comprehensive and diversified banking training

• Opportunity to gain professional experience in an innovative, multicultural and expanding company

• Sharing and sharing experiences with our community of about 25 apprentices based in Swissquote

Wenn Sie als Lehrling zu uns kommen, begeben Sie sich auf eine 3-jährige Reise zu den verschiedenen Teams, die Swissquote, den Leiter der Online-Bank in der Schweiz, machen.
Kommen Sie und erkunden Sie unsere Welt, indem Sie einem umfassenden und abwechslungsreichen Schulungskurs folgen. Nach diesen drei Jahren bei uns können Sie sich an dem Job orientieren, den Sie am meisten geliebt haben.
Neben unserer praktischen Ausbildung können Sie auch die spezialisierten und allgemeinen Kulturkurse der kaufmännischen Berufsschule belegen.

Und das ist noch nicht alles! Wir bieten auch große Vorteile, wie zum Beispiel den halben Preis oder Vorzugsangebote für Sport (Fitness, Klettern, Fußball...).

Mit dem Beitritt zu Swisssquote integrieren Sie mehr als ein Unternehmen, aber ein junges Arbeitsumfeld (35 Jahre Durchschnittsalter), unterschiedlich (70 verschiedene Nationalitäten) und freundlich (keine Kleiderordnung erforderlich).
Dann komm und wachse mit uns auf!

• Haben Sie gerade Ihre Schulpflicht beendet?

• Sprechen Sie fließend Französisch?

• Haben Sie eine gute Basis in Englisch?

• Freuen Sie sich darauf, den Bankenbereich zu entdecken?

• Können Sie dynamisch und willens sein?
Bringen Sie all diese Qualitäten zusammen? Fühlen Sie sich frei, sich online mit Ihrer vollständigen Datei zu bewerben:

- CV

- Begleitschreiben

- Bulletin der Notizen für die letzten drei Jahre.

Warum lernen Sie Swissquote?

• Umfassende und diversifizierte Bankausbildung

• Möglichkeit, Berufserfahrung in einem innovativen, multikulturellen und expandierenden Unternehmen zu sammeln

• Erfahrungsaustausch mit unserer Community von rund 25 Auszubildenden in Swissquote

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vuoi scoprire una banca interna e vivere un'esperienza di apprendimento unica in Svizzera?

Unendoci come apprendista, si sta avviando un viaggio di 4 anni tra le diverse squadre che fanno di Swissquote, il leader della banca online in Svizzera.
Vieni ad esplorare il nostro mondo seguendo un corso di formazione completo e vario. Guidato da un maestro di apprendimento, trascorrerai diverse sessioni da 6 a 9 mesi in diverse squadre di marketing per imparare i loro lavori principali e svolgere missioni concrete.
La professione mediatica combina creatività, tecnologie digitali, comunicazione e project management. Si lavorerà in un ambiente dinamico all'intersezione di elaborazione, progettazione, marketing e media.
Durante il vostro apprendistato, avrete l'opportunità di passare ai seguenti dipartimenti, e i vostri compiti principali includono:

• Project Management & Integration: supporto per la pianificazione e il monitoraggio dei progetti, supporto per l'integrazione CMS e l'integrazione e-mail, ...

• Brand Management: partecipare alla pianificazione e realizzazione di campagne di marketing, follow-up di promozioni, analisi dei risultati, ...

• Social Media: Collaborare nella gestione dei social network, contribuire a creare contenuti, gestione della comunità, ...

• Comunicazione interna: creare comunicazioni interne, proporre e implementare miglioramenti per intranet, ...

• Digital marketing & SEO: Monitorare le prestazioni degli articoli del blog, consigliare nuovi articoli e illustrarli, seguire con i creatori di contenuti, ...

• Design: creazione di contenuti (grafica, video, audio, brochure, newsletter), comprensione delle esigenze degli utenti e progettazione di esperienze rilevanti, ...

• Web Development: sviluppo e gestione di siti web (apprendimento come utilizzare diverse lingue web come HTML, CSS, PHP, JavaScript), ...
Oltre alla nostra formazione pratica, sarete anche in grado di prendere i corsi di cultura specializzati e generali della scuola professionale commerciale.

E non è tutto! Offriamo anche grandi vantaggi, come le offerte pagate a metà prezzo o preferenziali per lo sport (fitness, arrampicata, calcio...).

Con l'adesione a Swisssquote, si integrano più di una società ma un ambiente di lavoro giovane (35 anni di età media), varie (70 nazionalità diverse) e amichevole (senza codice abito richiesto).
Allora vieni a crescere con noi!

• Hai appena finito la tua educazione obbligatoria?

• Parli francese fluentemente e hai un buon background inglese?

Responsabilità chiave

• Organizzare e strutturare i dati di gestione dei casi per fornire una visione completa in tempo reale dei volumi, degli arretrati, del carico di lavoro e della produttività SLA in tutto il dipartimento.

• Costruire dashboard e report per uso gestionale (ad esempio tramite strumenti Tableau o simili), trasformando i dati grezzi in punti di vista chiari e decision-ready.

• Tradurre le priorità di gestione.s di reporting e misurazione in strutture pratiche di dati e dashboard.

• Analisi dei processi per individuare e implementare le opportunità di automazione tattica, lavorando con i team tecnici di Swissquote sulle iniziative di workflow aziendali pertinenti.

• Agire come punto di contatto unico per tutte le questioni connesse con il sistema, compresa la fornitura di audit e di estratti di dati basati su norme e la comunicazione, se necessario.

• Laurea magistrale in un campo quantitativo, informatica o informatica

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di analisi dei dati o di reporting, idealmente all'interno dei servizi finanziari o di un ambiente regolamentato.

• Forte padronanza pratica con strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati e di reporting (ad esempio, Tableau, PowerBI o equivalenti)

• Forte abilità Excel; conoscenza di lavoro di SQL per interrogare ed estrarre i dati dai sistemi di gestione dei casi.

• Conoscenza di lavoro della mappatura dei processi e degli strumenti di automazione del flusso di lavoro a basso codice/senza codice

• Capacità di tradurre i dati operativi / casi in dashboard e report chiari e di management-ready.

• Comprensione e/o forte appetito per saperne di più sugli argomenti Risk & Compliance all'interno di una banca svizzera

descriptionByLocale.en:
Role Overview
As Data, Oversight & Transformation Lead, you will drive BRM's data and transformation agenda, building the reporting infrastructure and dashboards that give management a complete, real-time view of the department's activity, and turning that data into insight that feeds strategic decision-making. Reporting directly to the Head of Business Risk Management, you will work closely with operational teams to structure and validate the data BRM generates, and with Swissquote's technical teams on strategic projects, including related workflow and automation initiatives.
Key Responsibilities

• Organize and structure case management data to provide a complete, real-time view of volumes, backlogs, workload, and SLA / productivity across the department.

• Build dashboards and reports for management use (e.g., via Tableau or similar tools), turning raw case data into clear, decision-ready views.

• Translate management’s reporting and measurement priorities into practical data structures and dashboards.

• Analyse processes to identify and implement tactical automation opportunities, working with Swissquote's technical teams on relevant enterprise workflow initiatives.

• Act as single point of contact for all dat-related matters, including provision of audit and regulatory-driven data extractions and reporting as needed.

• Master's degree in a Quantitative field, Computer Science or Data Science

• At least 5 years' experience in a data analytics or reporting role, ideally within financial services or a regulated environment.

• Strong hands-on proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI or equivalent)

• Strong Excel skills; working knowledge of SQL to query and extract data from case management systems.

• Working knowledge of process mapping and low code / no-code workflow automation tools

• Ability to translate operational / case data into clear, management-ready dashboards and reports.

• Understanding and/ or solid appetite to learn more about Risk & Compliance topics within a Swiss bank

• Familiarity with data privacy regulations (GDPR, etc.)

• Excellent communication skills in English, with French being an asset.

“Please note that Swissquote never requests sensitive personal information or payment of any kind during the recruitment process. Any such request is fraudulent.”

• Beteiligen Sie sich an wichtigen regulatorischen Projekten im Zusammenhang mit digitalen Assets und tragen Sie zur Optimierung interner Prozesse und Richtlinien bei.

• Entwurf, Überprüfung und Pflege interner Richtlinien, Verfahren und Richtlinien in Bezug auf digitale Assets und kryptobezogene Aktivitäten.

• Bereitstellung von Schulungen und Unterstützung für neue Mitarbeiter zu betrieblichen Prozessen und Bereitstellung von Anleitungen für Compliance-Teams zum effektiven Einsatz digitaler Tools und Systeme.

• Beantworten Sie Anfragen und Informationsanfragen von Regulierungsbehörden, Gegenparteien und der FINMA zu digitalen Vermögenswerten, kryptowährungsbezogenen Angelegenheiten und damit verbundenen Compliance-Themen.

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss, vorzugsweise in Jura oder Wirtschaft, oder nachgewiesene einschlägige Erfahrung in der AML / CTF-Compliance, einschließlich digitaler Assets.

• Mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position innerhalb eines Finanzinstituts oder in einer AML/CTF-Compliance-Rolle in Bezug auf digitale Vermögenswerte.

• Bewährte Erfahrung in der Blockchain-Analyse, Krypto-Due-Diligence-, Fondsquelle und Vermögensquelle-Bewertungen mit einem starken Verständnis der damit verbundenen Finanzkriminalitätsrisiken.

• Erfahrung mit Blockchain Analytics Tools wie Lukka, TRM Labs, Chainalysis oder gleichwertigen Lösungen.

• Kenntnis der Schweizer AML-Gesetze, einschließlich AMLA, AMLO-FINMA und CDB, und anderer anwendbarer Vorschriften.

• Ausgezeichnete Beherrschung von Englisch und Französisch. Andere Sprachen sind ein starkes Kapital.

• Analytischer und methodischer Ansatz mit starken Schreib- und Dokumentationsfähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit zum Multitasking und Arbeiten unter Druck.

• Starker Teamplayer, der gerne in einem multikulturellen, dynamischen, technologischen und internationalen Umfeld arbeitet.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Endpoint Engineer è un membro chiave del team Endpoint Administration & Protection, responsabile per la gestione, la conformità, la protezione e il ciclo di vita dei endpoint aziendali in tutta l'organizzazione. Il ruolo porta competenze specialistiche in macOS e piattaforme mobili tra cui iOS, iPadOS e Android, completando le funzionalità Windows esistenti del team. Lavorando principalmente con Microsoft Intune e Microsoft Defender per Endpoint, l'Ingegnere Endpoint garantisce che gli endpoint rimangano sicuri, conformi, operativi e allineati ai requisiti di business e sicurezza. Il candidato di successo è curioso, adattabile e proattivo, cercando continuamente opportunità per migliorare l'esperienza endpoint, aumentare l'automazione e rafforzare la postura di sicurezza endpoint.
macOS e gestione dei dispositivi mobili

• Agire come principale specialista tecnico per macOS, iOS, iPadOS e Android endpoint management.

• Progettazione, implementare e mantenere le capacità di gestione dei dispositivi utilizzando le tecnologie Microsoft Intune e platform-native.

• Gestisci l'integrazione di Apple Business Manager, i processi automatizzati di registrazione dei dispositivi (ADE) e del ciclo di vita dei dispositivi Apple.

• Gestisci modelli di registrazione Android Enterprise e amministrazione operativa.

• Assicurare che i dispositivi siano iscritti, conformi, correttamente configurati e supportati durante il loro ciclo di vita.

• Risoluzione dei problemi complessi di gestione dei dispositivi, registrazione e problemi di configurazione su piattaforme supportate.

• Fornire assistenza tecnica e documentazione per amministratori di endpoint, team di Service Desk e stakeholder.
Gestione della conformità e della configurazione

• Progettare, implementare e mantenere i profili di configurazione Microsoft Intune, le restrizioni dei dispositivi e le politiche di gestione endpoint.

• Sviluppare e mantenere le politiche di conformità del dispositivo e la reportistica di conformità su tutte le piattaforme supportate.

• Supporta l'integrazione tra politiche di conformità e controlli di accesso condizionale in collaborazione con i team Identity e Information Security.

• Mantenere i metodi di registrazione e i flussi di lavoro di provisioning, compresa la consapevolezza dei processi di Windows Autopilot e dei punti di integrazione.

• Monitorare la salute della piattaforma, la configurazione deriva e l'efficacia della politica.

• Valutare costantemente le nuove funzionalità Microsoft Intune e raccomandare l'adozione dove il valore aziendale esiste.
Protezione endpoint e Microsoft Defender per Endpoint

• Possedere la salute operativa e l'applicazione di Microsoft Defender per Endpoint attraverso Windows, macOS e piattaforme mobili.

• Assicurare Defender onboarding, distribuzione, assegnazione di policy, reporting e salute agente rimangono a livelli di servizio target.

• Implementare e mantenere i controlli di sicurezza endpoint definiti da Information Security.

• Monitorare la copertura di protezione, lo stato di salute e le lacune di distribuzione attraverso la proprietà endpoint.

• Produci piani di reporting operativo e di bonifica per dispositivi non conformi o non protetti.

• Collaborare con le operazioni di sicurezza durante le indagini che richiedono visibilità endpoint o azioni di bonifica.

• Mantenere piattaforme di protezione endpoint per le versioni supportate e sicure.
La sicurezza delle informazioni definisce gli standard di sicurezza, le linee di base e i requisiti di controllo. Questo ruolo è responsabile per l'attuazione, l'attuazione, l'esecuzione, il funzionamento e il mantenimento di tali controlli sulle piattaforme endpoint e la segnalazione sulla conformità, la copertura e le lacune operative.
Imballaggio e distribuzione dell'applicazione

• Pacchetto, test, distribuzione e manutenzione delle applicazioni tramite Microsoft Intune per dispositivi Windows e macOS.

• Gestisci applicazioni Win32, implementazioni MSI, wrapper eseguibili, applicazioni Microsoft Store, applicazioni Line-of-Business e pacchetti applicativi macOS.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Endpoint Engineer is a key member of the Endpoint Administration & Protection team, responsible for the management, compliance, protection and lifecycle of corporate endpoints across the organisation. The role brings specialist expertise in macOS and mobile platforms including iOS, iPadOS and Android, complementing the team's existing Windows capabilities. Working primarily with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, the Endpoint Engineer ensures that endpoints remain secure, compliant, operational and aligned with business and security requirements. The successful candidate is curious, adaptable and proactive, continuously seeking opportunities to improve the endpoint experience, increase automation and strengthen endpoint security posture.
macOS and Mobile Device Management

• Act as the primary technical specialist for macOS, iOS, iPadOS and Android endpoint management.

• Design, implement and maintain device management capabilities using Microsoft Intune and platform-native technologies.

• Manage Apple Business Manager integration, Automated Device Enrollment (ADE) and Apple device lifecycle processes.

• Manage Android Enterprise enrollment models and operational administration.

• Ensure devices are enrolled, compliant, properly configured and supported throughout their lifecycle.

• Troubleshoot complex device management, enrollment and configuration issues across supported platforms.

• Provide technical guidance and documentation for endpoint administrators, Service Desk teams and stakeholders.
Intune Compliance and Configuration Management

• Design, implement and maintain Microsoft Intune configuration profiles, device restrictions and endpoint management policies.

• Develop and maintain device compliance policies and compliance reporting across all supported platforms.

• Support integration between compliance policies and Conditional Access controls in collaboration with Identity and Information Security teams.

• Maintain enrollment methods and provisioning workflows, including awareness of Windows Autopilot processes and integration points.

• Monitor platform health, configuration drift and policy effectiveness.

• Continuously evaluate new Microsoft Intune capabilities and recommend adoption where business value exists.
Endpoint Protection and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

• Own the operational health and enforcement of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint across Windows, macOS and mobile platforms.

• Ensure Defender onboarding, deployment, policy assignment, reporting and agent health remain at target service levels.

• Implement and maintain endpoint security controls defined by Information Security.

• Monitor protection coverage, health status and deployment gaps across the endpoint estate.

• Produce operational reporting and remediation plans for non-compliant or unprotected devices.

• Collaborate with Security Operations during investigations requiring endpoint visibility or remediation actions.

• Maintain endpoint protection platforms to supported and secure versions.
Information Security defines security standards, baselines and control requirements. This role is responsible for implementing, enforcing, operating and maintaining those controls on endpoint platforms and reporting on compliance, coverage and operational gaps.
Application Packaging and Deployment

• Package, test, deploy and maintain applications through Microsoft Intune for both Windows and macOS devices.

• Manage Win32 applications, MSI deployments, executable wrappers, Microsoft Store applications, Line-of-Business applications and macOS application packages.

• Develop deployment strategies that minimise user disruption and maximise reliability.

• Manage application lifecycle processes including onboarding, updating, supersedence, retirement and removal.

• Support update rings and deployment strategies for operating systems and applications.

• Maintain documentation, testing procedures and deployment standards.
Operations and Continuous Improvement

• Monitor service health, platform performance and compliance metrics across endpoint technologies.

• Investigate root causes of recurring issues and implement permanent corrective actions.

• Identify opportunities for automation, simplification and service improvement.

• Maintain accurate technical documentation, standards and operational procedures.

• Participate in incident resolution, problem management and change processes.

• Stay current with Microsoft roadmap developments, endpoint security trends and modern management practices.

• Take ownership of problems and initiatives through to completion, ensuring solutions are documented and operationally sustainable.

• 4+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, endpoint administration or modern workplace management roles.

• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune administration and endpoint management.

• Experience managing macOS devices in enterprise environments.

• Experience managing iOS, iPadOS and Android devices using enterprise MDM solutions.

• Strong understanding of device compliance policies, configuration profiles and enrollment methods.

• Experience implementing and operating Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

• Experience with application packaging and deployment for Windows and macOS platforms.

• Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access integration.

• Experience troubleshooting endpoint, operating system and device management issues.

• Strong documentation and operational process discipline.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Desirable Skills

• Scripting experience using PowerShell, Bash, Mac Shell Scripts or Python.

• Experience with Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrollment.

• Experience with Windows Autopilot.

• Experience with Jamf Pro or comparable Apple management platforms.

• Experience with endpoint automation and reporting using Microsoft Graph.

• Familiarity with security operations processes and endpoint incident response.

• Microsoft MD-102 certification.

• Microsoft security, endpoint management or modern workplace certifications.
Mindset, Behaviours and Ways of Working
We are looking for someone who combines strong technical capability with a continuous improvement mindset.

• Dynamic and adaptive, comfortable working in environments where technology, security requirements and business priorities evolve frequently.

• Demonstrates a growth mindset by actively learning new technologies and continuously improving professional knowledge.

• Naturally curious and focused on understanding root causes, not simply addressing symptoms.

• Takes initiative, identifies improvement opportunities and follows them through to completion.

• Demonstrates ownership and accountability for operational outcomes.

• Approaches incidents and challenges as opportunities to learn and strengthen services.

• Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Collaborates effectively across engineering, security and support teams.

• Maintains a strong customer and service-oriented mindset while balancing risk and security requirements.
What We Offer

• The opportunity to work with modern endpoint management and security technologies at enterprise scale.

• A collaborative engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement.

• Exposure to cross-functional initiatives involving Information Security, Security Operations and Workplace Technology teams.

• Opportunities for professional development, certification and ongoing technical learning.

• The ability to influence endpoint strategy, platform evolution and service improvement initiatives.

• Flexible ways of working and a supportive team environment focused on knowledge sharing and engineering excellence.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join the Finance Department as a Financial Accountant, reporting to the Accounting Team Lead, and help us maintain the highest standards of financial accuracy, compliance, and reporting excellence.
In this role, you will work in a fast-paced environment, managing a wide variety of accounting and financial reporting activities. You will use analytical skills in your day-to-day work, provide timely and accurate financial information to support decision-making, and proactively identify opportunities to improve processes and controls.
More broadly, your role will be to ensure that all business transactions and events relevant to the company's financial position are recorded accurately, comprehensively, and systematically. Together with your team, you will ensure compliance with applicable accounting principles, regulatory requirements, policies, and standards.
You will contribute to providing internal and external stakeholders with a clear and reliable view of the company's financial position and performance. As a Financial Accountant, you will also support senior management with financial planning, analysis, and reporting.
Responsibilities:

• Maintain general ledger, prepare journal entries and produce various accounting schedules/reconciliation in accordance with various GAAPSs either for the bank in Switzerland (IFRS and ARB-FINMA) or for one of the foreign subsidiaries (local GAAP).

• Prepare and review monthly, quarterly and annual financial closings. Actively participate in the half-year and year-end closing, with responsibility for specific topics and notes to the financial statements. This includes preparation of answers to external auditors.

• Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies, unusual movements and ageing items.

• Review journal entries, accruals, provisions, prepayments and other accounting adjustments.

• Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for banking transactions and financial instruments.

• Support the preparation of statutory and management financial statements.

• Contribute to the preparation of consolidated financial reporting where applicable.

• Take responsibility in accounting projects as assigned by Management,

• Provide accounting guidance and implement appropriate solutions for complex accounting issues and queries raised by various departments and foreign group entities

• Prepare miscellaneous regulatory filings (for the SNB or FINMA as example)  as assigned.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent diploma in accounting, finance or economics.

• Minimum 5 years’ experience in a similar role ideally in the banking industry.

• You must be fluent in French and English (oral and written).

• You are adaptable and experienced in managing complex financial matters within a dynamic environment.

• You are meticulous, able to collaborate cross functionally and to work on several subjects in parallel, attentive to details with very good organisation skills.

• Strong understanding of the banking business, with the ability to see the bigger picture and understand the broader financial context.

• You have experience with IFRS and generally accepted accounting principles in Switzerland (Accounting Rules for Banks “ARB-FINMA” is a plus).

• Your skills in MS Office (Excel in particular) are excellent. Knowledge of PowerBI, SQL and/or Python are a plus.

• Knowledge of software Temenos T24 and OneStream is considered a plus.

The department is focusing on the design and operation of electronic trading systems with the core mission to provide an excellent execution service to clients, to profitably manage the market risk of the bank, and to ensure orderly operations and orderly functioning of markets.
With our technology and data-driven approach we add an alpha to our product quality and increase the profitability of our business with improvements from the supply side: not only by sourcing smarter but as well by producing liquidity.
The department consists of 3 teams with a functional focus: Spot, STIR, and Execution.

The Execution Team is the operational backbone of the department ensuring competitive liquidity and orderly execution across all platforms and all asset classes with a 24/5 on-site presence. The team as well runs the Physical Spot FX Risk Book and collaborates with the Spot and STIR teams to ensure profitable operation of all books at all times. The Execution Team is typically the first point of contact for our clients and internal stakeholders including Sales, IT, Controlling, Treasury, Middle and Back Office. The team works closely with engineers and project managers to continuously improve our products and operations.
As a Trader your key responsibilities will be:

• Quoting and Executing clients’ spot, forward and options orders in FX, Precious Metals, Commodity Futures, Index Futures, and Stocks CFDs,

• Monitoring electronic pricing & trading systems, trade flow, liquidity,

• Ensuring efficient execution with Liquidity Providers.

• Manage Banks positions with Prime Brokers and improve financing conditions in collaboration with the treasury department,

• Liaise with internal stakeholders such as risk, distribution, development, project, and IT departments to improve the services and the profitability of the bank,

In this role, you will:

• Migrate and modernize production applications on Kubernetes,

• Integrate third-party software into our production platforms and make it fit our operational standards,

• Work alongside Software and IT Engineers to improve reliability, performance and operational readiness,

• Design and operate applications on our service mesh platform,

• Integrate safe deployment patterns such as canary releases and progressive rollouts,

• Define SLOs, SLIs and useful operational KPIs, then use them to drive improvements,

• Improve observability across metrics, logs and traces so problems are easier to spot and understand,

• Explore and integrate AI tools that can help with troubleshooting, incident analysis and remediation,

• Test how systems behave under load, during failures and when dependencies disappear,

• Automate repetitive operational work whenever it makes sense,

• Provide Level-3 support and participate in the on-call rotation.

• At least 3 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering or a similar production-focused role,

• Solid hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes, OpenShift, EKS or a similar Kubernetes platform,

• Good knowledge of Helm and how to package, configure and maintain applications with it,

• Experience working with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd, or strong Kubernetes networking experience,

• A good understanding of service-to-service networking, traffic routing, mTLS and TLS,

• Experience with GitOps and modern deployment strategies such as canary or progressive delivery,

• A practical understanding of SRE concepts such as SLIs, SLOs and error budgets,

• Experience with observability and tracing tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Stack or OpenTelemetry,

• Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS and load balancing,

• Comfortable troubleshooting JVM-based applications in production and able to investigate issues related to heap usage, garbage collection or JVM configuration,

• Comfortable automating things with Python, Go, Bash or another programming language,

• Experience or strong interest in applying AI to observability, incident response or operational automation,

• Experience or a strong interest in operating applications that depend on GPU resources or other AI infrastructure,

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible or Puppet.
Nice-to-Haves

• Experience with Argo CD, Argo Rollouts or Argo Workflows,

• Deeper experience with Istio, Linkerd or Envoy-based service mesh platforms,

• Experience designing or operating Kubernetes platforms at scale,

• Experience running Java or Spring Boot applications in production,

• Hands-on experience tuning JVM applications for performance or low-latency workloads,

• Experience integrating applications with self-hosted AI platforms such as vLLM,

• Experience troubleshooting AI infrastructure integrations, including model access, GPU availability and NVIDIA MIG configurations.

• Knowledge of Cilium, eBPF or other modern Kubernetes networking technologies,

• Experience with public cloud or large private cloud environments,

• CKAD, CKA, CKS or equivalent hands-on Kubernetes experience,

• A homelab, self-hosted services or side projects where you get to experiment, break things and build them again.
Who You Are

• You like understanding why systems behave the way they do, especially when something goes wrong,

• You automate repetitive work instead of accepting it as part of the job,

• You’re comfortable working across development, infrastructure and operations teams,

• You don’t mind getting deep into software you didn’t build yourself,

• You’re curious about AI and where it can genuinely improve day-to-day operations,

• You are fluent in English and have good conversational French,

• You enjoy keeping up with cloud-native technologies and trying new approaches when they solve a real problem.

• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités pour élargir et différencier Swissquote, offre bancaire.

• Surveiller les tendances du marché, les concurrents et les technologies émergentes pour éclairer la stratégie de produit.

• Diriger des initiatives interfonctionnelles pour lancer de nouveaux services bancaires et améliorer ceux qui existent déjà.

• Veiller à ce que l'offre bancaire évolue en fonction de Swissquote, de la stratégie de produits plus large et des ambitions à long terme.

• Une bonne compréhension des produits et services bancaires, notamment les paiements, les cartes, les transferts ou le crédit.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua missione
Ti piace aiutare le persone e imparare cose nuove? In caso affermativo, potresti essere la soluzione perfetta per la nostra posizione di Rappresentante della Customer Care. Sarete il collegamento principale tra Yuh e i nostri clienti fantastici, che utilizzano la nostra app per gestire le loro finanze e gli investimenti. Risponderai alle loro domande, risolverai i loro problemi e li guiderai attraverso il loro viaggio finanziario con Yuh.
Responsabilità chiave

• Servire come punto di contatto principale per i clienti, la gestione di chiamate in entrata e in uscita (circa 70-80% delle attività quotidiane), e fornire un'esperienza clienti costantemente professionale e positiva.

• Fornire un supporto accurato via telefono, assicurando la qualità del servizio di prima classe. Risolvere le richieste dei clienti, i problemi e le richieste relative alla Yuh App nei settori pagano, risparmiare e gli investimenti.

• Guidare attivamente e sostenere i clienti, soprattutto al telefono, attraverso il loro viaggio finanziario, spiegando prodotti, caratteristiche e processi in modo chiaro, empatico, amichevole e compiacente.

• Assicurare i più alti livelli di soddisfazione del cliente eseguendo le istruzioni del cliente e affrontando le preoccupazioni con cordialità e professionalità, soprattutto in situazioni sensibili al tempo o complesse.

• Documentare con precisione le interazioni e i risultati dei clienti nei sistemi interni, garantendo un corretto follow-up e trasparenza tra le squadre. Collaborare a stretto contatto con altri rappresentanti della Customer Care e dipartimenti interni per garantire la fornitura di servizi senza soluzione di continuità e contribuire intuizioni per piattaforme, servizi e miglioramenti del processo.

• Sostenere i principi del trattamento equo dei clienti, della riservatezza e della conformità normativa in ogni momento.

• Apprendistato completo (certificato federale di competenza (Fähigkeitszeungnis / Fachausweis/ Berufsmatura)

• Esperienza precedente nella soddisfazione del cliente, preferibilmente nei servizi finanziari nella gestione delle richieste e dei reclami dei clienti

• Fluency in inglese e tedesco. Per questa posizione, la competenza italiana è altamente raccomandata.

• Un forte interesse per i prodotti e i mercati finanziari, tra cui azioni, ETF e criptovalute

• Ottima comunicazione – verbale e scritta – competenze

• Familiarità con software per ufficio e sistemi telefonici

• Siete particolarmente abili nell'ascolto, nella comunicazione, nell'empatia e nell'essere spersuasive

• Hai un atteggiamento proattivo e “può fare”

• Ti piace lavorare in una squadra
descriptionByLocale.en:
Your mission
Do you love helping people and learning new things? If so, you might be the perfect fit for our Customer Care Representative position. You will be the main link between Yuh and our awesome clients, who use our app to manage their finances and investments. You will answer their questions, solve their problems, and guide them through their financial journey with Yuh.
Key Responsabilities

• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, handling of inbound and outbound phone calls (approximately 70–80% of daily activities), and delivering a consistently professional and positive customer experience.

• Provide accurate support via telephone, ensuring first class service quality. Resolving client inquiries, issues and requests related to the Yuh App in the sectors pay, save and investments.

• Actively guide and support clients, mainly over the phone, through their financial journey, explaining products, features and processes in a clear, empathetic, friendly and compliant manner.

• Ensure the highest levels of client satisfaction by executing client instructions and addressing concerns with friendliness and professionalism, especially in time sensitive or complex situations.

• Accurately document client interactions and outcomes in internal systems, ensuring proper follow-up and transparency across teams. Collaborate closely with other Customer Care Representatives and internal departments to ensure seamless service delivery and contribute insights for platform, service, and process improvements.

• Uphold the principles of fair client treatment, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance at all times.

• Completed apprenticeship (Federal certificate of Competence (Fähigkeitszeungnis / Fachausweis/ Berufsmatura)

• Previous experience in customer satisfaction, preferably in financial services in handling customer enquiries and complaints

• Fluency in English and German. For this position, Italian proficiency is highly recommended.

• A strong interest for financial product and markets, including stocks, ETFs and cryptocurrencies

• Excellent communication – verbal and written – skills

• Familiarity with office software and phone systems

• You are particularly skilled at listening, communicating, showing empathy, and being spersuasive

• You have a proactive and “can do” attitude

• You like working in a team

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Head Controlling & Risk leads the Controlling & Risk department and oversees a multidisciplinary team of approximately 20 employees organised across specialised risks The role is responsible for ensuring that credit, market, liquidity, operational and related regulatory risks are identified, monitored, challenged and reported across the Group in line with the risk appetite defined by the Board of Directors.
The role also oversees the Group’s internal control framework, ensuring that key controls, governance standards and related documentation remain effective, consistent and appropriately monitored.
Key Responsibilities

• Leadership and department management: define the department’s priorities and operating model; lead, coach and develop managers and teams; ensure effective resource allocation and continuous upskilling.

• Risk governance and reporting: produce and present clear reports for the Risk Committee, Executive Management and the Board of Directors; ensure adequate escalation of material risk developments, incidents, KRIs and remediation actions.

• Risk framework ownership: maintain and continuously improve the Group risk management and internal control frameworks, including policies, methodologies, risk appetite monitoring, risk taxonomy, controls and reporting standards; draft, review and update risk policies, procedures and governance documents; support the development of structured approached to assess risk culture, control effectiveness and internal control maturity

The Head Controlling & Risk provides strategic direction and effective challenge across the following areas, acting as the senior point of contact for C&R teams, other internal stakeholders, governance bodies and regulators on Controlling & Risk matters:

• Credit, market and liquidity risks – own investments: oversee concentration analysis, limit monitoring, stress testing, RWA, capital & liquidity planning and related risk indicators.

• Credit and market risks – client activities: oversee the monitoring of clients active in ETD trading, lending and eFX trading, including trading conditions, margin parameters, daily margin call analysis, stress testing and market watch.

• Operational risk management: oversee the identification, assessment, monitoring and reporting of operational risks, excluding dedicated IT and AML topics where separate specialised functions exist; coordinate the RCSA framework, KRIs, incidents and action management monitoring.

• Reconciliation activities: supervise the reconciliation of cash, securities and cryptocurrencies with external counterparties and custodians, ensuring timely escalation and remediation of discrepancies.

• Consolidated supervision: contribute to Group-level oversight by ensuring consistent risk standards, reporting and escalation across relevant entities and activities.

• Regulatory relations: liaise with FINMA, SIX and other relevant stakeholders on Controlling & Risk topics, and oversee alignment with applicable regulatory requirements.

• Projects, change and new business initiatives: contribute to New Business Initiative risk analyses, process improvements, automation initiatives and risk-related transformation projects, including the development of dashboards, maturity assessments and monitoring frameworks supporting continuous improvement of risk governance and internal controls.

• In-scope products and activities: mainstream securities, including bonds, equities, structured products and precious metals; exchange-traded derivatives; cryptocurrencies and digital assets; eFX and interbank FX products, including CFDs on multiple underlyings, spot and forward FX.

• Master's degree in a relevant field; a recognised professional qualification in risk, internal controls, audit or finance (e.g. FRM, PRM, CIA, CRMA, CISA or CFA) is strongly preferred.

• 10+ years of experience in a leadership position in banking, financial services, risk management or a related field, including substantial leadership experience, ideally within a regulated and international financial institution.

• Proven experience with responsibility for multiple risk disciplines and/or multidisciplinary teams, including exposure to risk governance, internal control frameworks and organisational or control maturity initiatives.

• Strong strategic leadership and experience managing multidisciplinary expert teams.

• Broad expertise in credit, market, liquidity and operational risk within a banking environment.

• Solid knowledge of Swiss banking regulation, FINMA expectations and Basel standards, ideally within a Category 3 bank.

• Strong strategic thinking, business acumen and judgement.

• Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with the ability to balance risk, business growth and operational efficiency.

• Strong communication, presentation and writing skills, including risk reports, policies and Board-level materials

• Confident constructive challenger, with high integrity, independence and credibility.

• Technology-minded, with a strong interest in digitalisation, data and AI.

• Additional assets: Understanding of ICT, cyber and data-security risks. Experience with GRC platforms, RCSA, KRI and incident management workflows. Quantitative/model risk and stress-testing expertise. Data science, AI and automation applied to risk monitoring and reporting.

Der Head Controlling & Risk leitet die Abteilung Controlling & Risk und betreut ein multidisziplinäres Team von ca. 20 Mitarbeitern, das über spezialisierte Risiken verteilt ist. Die Rolle ist dafür verantwortlich, sicherzustellen, dass Kredit-, Markt-, Liquiditäts-, operative und damit verbundene regulatorische Risiken gruppenweit im Einklang mit der vom Verwaltungsrat definierten Risikobereitschaft identifiziert, überwacht, angefochten und gemeldet werden.
Die Rolle überwacht auch den internen Kontrollrahmen der Gruppe und stellt sicher, dass wichtige Kontrollen, Governance-Standards und die damit verbundene Dokumentation wirksam, konsistent und angemessen überwacht bleiben.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Führung und Abteilungsmanagement: Definieren Sie die Prioritäten und das Betriebsmodell der Abteilung; führen, coachen und entwickeln Sie Manager und Teams; gewährleisten Sie eine effektive Ressourcenallokation und kontinuierliche Weiterbildung.

• Risikomanagement und Berichterstattung: Erstellung und Vorlage klarer Berichte für den Risikoausschuss, die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat; Gewährleistung einer angemessenen Eskalation von wesentlichen Risikoentwicklungen, Vorfällen, KRI und Abhilfemaßnahmen.

• Eigentümerschaft von Risikorahmen: Pflege und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Rahmenbedingungen für das Risikomanagement und die interne Kontrolle der Gruppe, einschließlich Richtlinien, Methoden, Überwachung der Risikobereitschaft, Risikotaxonomie, Kontrollen und Berichtsstandards; Ausarbeitung, Überprüfung und Aktualisierung von Risikorichtlinien, Verfahren und Governance-Dokumenten; Unterstützung der Entwicklung strukturierter Ansätze zur Bewertung der Risikokultur, der Wirksamkeit der Kontrollen und der Reife der internen Kontrolle

Der Head Controlling & Risk bietet strategische Ausrichtung und effektive Herausforderung in den folgenden Bereichen und fungiert als leitender Ansprechpartner für C&R-Teams, andere interne Stakeholder, Governance-Gremien und Regulierungsbehörden in Controlling & Risk-Fragen:

• Regulatorische Beziehungen: Verbindung mit FINMA, SIX und anderen relevanten Stakeholdern zu Controlling & Risk-Themen und Überwachung der Angleichung an die geltenden regulatorischen Anforderungen.

• Projekte, Veränderungen und neue Geschäftsinitiativen: Beitrag zu Risikoanalysen, Prozessverbesserungen, Automatisierungsinitiativen und risikobezogenen Transformationsprojekten der New Business Initiative, einschließlich der Entwicklung von Dashboards, Reifebewertungen und Monitoring-Frameworks zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Risikosteuerung und internen Kontrollen.

• Master-Abschluss in einem relevanten Bereich; eine anerkannte berufliche Qualifikation in Risiko, interne Kontrollen, Audit oder Finanzen (z. B. FRM, PRM, CIA, CRMA, CISA oder CFA) wird stark bevorzugt.

• 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer Führungsposition im Bankwesen, Finanzdienstleistungen, Risikomanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich, einschließlich erheblicher Führungserfahrung, idealerweise in einem regulierten und internationalen Finanzinstitut.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Verantwortung für mehrere Risikodisziplinen und/oder multidisziplinäre Teams, einschließlich Risikosteuerung, interner Kontrollrahmen und organisatorischer oder Kontrollreifeinitiativen.

• Starke strategische Führung und Erfahrung im Management multidisziplinärer Expertenteams.

• Breite Expertise in Kredit-, Markt-, Liquiditäts- und Betriebsrisiken im Bankenumfeld.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse der Schweizer Bankenregulierung, der Erwartungen der FINMA und der Baseler Standards, idealerweise innerhalb einer Kategorie-3-Bank.

• Starke Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Schreibfähigkeiten, einschließlich Risikoberichte, Richtlinien und Materialien auf Vorstandsebene
