descriptionByLocale.it:
Come Junior Business Risk Officer, si unirà al Dipartimento Business Risk Management (BRM), una prima linea chiave della funzione di difesa che lavora all'interfaccia tra le funzioni di business e controllo. Collaborando a stretto contatto con i team di Sales e Compliance Istituzionali, aiuterete a facilitare la crescita sostenibile delle imprese, assicurando che le relazioni con i clienti siano valutate attraverso una lente pragmatica e basata sui rischi, rispettando gli obblighi normativi della Banca.
Questo ruolo si trova all'incrocio tra business e rischio. Potrai lavorare direttamente con i team di front-office, fornendo indicazioni pratiche in tutto il client di bordo e ciclo di vita, bilanciando gli obiettivi commerciali con una gestione del rischio sonoro.
Principali responsabilità

• Verificare e valutare le richieste di apertura dei conti per i clienti istituzionali, principalmente per le società operative, le istituzioni finanziarie e altri partner esterni, con un focus su AML/CTF, sanzioni, reputazione, conformità fiscale e rischi transfrontalieri.

• Agire come partner di rischio affidabile per il reparto vendite fornendo consulenza tempestiva, pragmatica e basata sul rischio su potenziali e relazioni client esistenti.

• Condurre le valutazioni di conformità delle imposte, compresi i requisiti di FATCA, CRS e Intermediario Qualificato (QI).

• Eseguire revisioni periodiche delle relazioni con i clienti esistenti, in particolare le istituzioni finanziarie e i partner esterni.

• Condurre attività di monitoraggio delle transazioni per un portafoglio designato di clienti istituti finanziari.

• Partecipa a incontri con potenziali clienti e clienti esistenti in cui è richiesto l'ingresso di Business Risk Management.

• Collaborare con Vendite, Compliance e altri stakeholder interni per facilitare l'accesso efficiente a bordo mantenendo adeguati standard di rischio.

• Contribuire al continuo miglioramento dei processi di bordo, dei controlli dei rischi e delle procedure interne.

• Buona conoscenza, o forte interesse, del quadro normativo svizzero applicabile alle istituzioni finanziarie, tra cui l'Anti-Money Laundering Act (AMLA), AMLO-FINMA, il Codice di condotta delle banche svizzere (CDB 20), sanziona i regolamenti e la relativa guida FINMA.

• L'esperienza in Business Risk Management, Compliance, AML/KYC o un'altra funzione di controllo all'interno del settore dei servizi finanziari è un bene.

• Forte interesse a lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di front-office in un ambiente dinamico e orientato al business.

• La comprensione dei quadri di conformità fiscale come FATCA, CRS e QI è un vantaggio.

• Laurea in Giurisprudenza, Economia, Finanza o un campo correlato è un bene.

• Eccellente capacità analitiche, organizzative e di problem solving.

• Capacità di prendere decisioni equilibrate e basate sul rischio, considerando gli obiettivi commerciali.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la fiducia di impegnarsi costruttivamente con le funzioni di business e controllo.

• Alto livello di integrità, giudizio professionale e discrezione.

• È richiesta una fluidità in inglese e francese. Il tedesco o un'altra lingua è considerato un bene.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Junior Business Risk Officer, you will join the Business Risk Management (BRM) Department, a key first line of defense function working at the interface between the business and control functions. Partnering closely with the Institutional Sales and Compliance teams, you will help facilitate sustainable business growth by ensuring that client relationships are assessed through a pragmatic, risk-based lens while meeting the Bank's regulatory obligations.
This role sits at the intersection of business and risk. You will work directly with front-office teams, providing practical guidance throughout the client onboarding and lifecycle, balancing commercial objectives with sound risk management.
Key Responsibilities

• Review and assess account opening requests for institutional clients, primarily for operating companies, financial institutions and other external partners, with a focus on AML/CTF, sanctions, reputational, tax compliance and cross-border risks.

• Act as a trusted risk partner to the Sales Department by providing timely, pragmatic and risk-based advice on prospective and existing client relationships.

• Conduct tax compliance assessments, including FATCA, CRS and Qualified Intermediary (QI) requirements.

• Perform periodic reviews of existing client relationships, particularly financial institutions and external partners.

• Conduct transaction monitoring activities for a designated portfolio of financial institution clients.

• Participate in meetings with prospective and existing clients where Business Risk Management input is required.

• Collaborate with Sales, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to facilitate efficient onboarding while maintaining appropriate risk standards.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of onboarding processes, risk controls and internal procedures.

• Good knowledge of, or a strong interest in, the Swiss regulatory framework applicable to financial institutions, including the Anti-Money Laundering Act (AMLA), AMLO-FINMA, the Swiss Banks' Code of Conduct (CDB 20), sanctions regulations and relevant FINMA guidance.

• Experience in Business Risk Management, Compliance, AML/KYC or another control function within the financial services industry is an asset.

• Strong interest in working closely with front-office teams in a dynamic, business-oriented environment.

• Understanding of tax compliance frameworks such as FATCA, CRS and QI is an advantage.

• University degree in Law, Economics, Finance or a related field is an asset.

• Excellent analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to make balanced, risk-based decisions while considering commercial objectives.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage constructively with both business and control functions.

• High level of integrity, professional judgement and discretion.

• Fluency in English and French is required. German or another language is considered an asset.
Starting date : asap

Indem Sie eng mit den Teams für institutionellen Vertrieb und Compliance zusammenarbeiten, tragen Sie zu einem nachhaltigen Geschäftswachstum bei, indem Sie sicherstellen, dass die Kundenbeziehungen durch eine pragmatische, risikobasierte Linse bewertet werden und gleichzeitig die regulatorischen Verpflichtungen der Bank erfüllt werden.
Diese Rolle sitzt an der Schnittstelle von Geschäft und Risiko. Sie arbeiten direkt mit Front-Office-Teams zusammen und bieten praktische Beratung während des gesamten Kunden-Onboardings und -Lebenszyklus und balancieren kommerzielle Ziele mit einem soliden Risikomanagement.

• Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Risikopartner für die Verkaufsabteilung, indem Sie zeitnahe, pragmatische und risikobasierte Beratung zu potenziellen und bestehenden Kundenbeziehungen anbieten.

• Führen Sie Steuerkonformitätsbewertungen durch, einschließlich FATCA-, CRS- und Qualified Intermediary (QI) -Anforderungen.

• Durchführung von Transaktionsüberwachungsaktivitäten für ein bestimmtes Portfolio von Finanzinstitutionskunden.

• Nehmen Sie an Besprechungen mit potenziellen und bestehenden Kunden teil, bei denen Business Risk Management-Input erforderlich ist.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que Junior Business Risk Officer, vous rejoindrez le département Gestion des risques de l'entreprise (GRP), une première ligne clé de la fonction de défense travaillant à l'interface entre les fonctions de gestion et de contrôle. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de vente et de conformité institutionnelles, vous faciliterez la croissance durable des entreprises en veillant à ce que les relations avec les clients soient évaluées au moyen d'une lentille pragmatique et axée sur le risque tout en respectant les obligations réglementaires de la Banque.
Ce rôle se situe à l'intersection des affaires et des risques. Vous travaillerez directement avec les équipes de front-office, fournissant des conseils pratiques tout au long du client à bord et du cycle de vie, en conciliant les objectifs commerciaux avec une saine gestion des risques.
Principales responsabilités

• Examiner et évaluer les demandes d'ouverture de compte pour les clients institutionnels, principalement pour les sociétés d'exploitation, les institutions financières et d'autres partenaires externes, en mettant l'accent sur la LMA/FCT, les sanctions, la réputation, la conformité fiscale et les risques transfrontaliers.

• Agir en tant que partenaire de confiance du Département des ventes en fournissant des conseils opportuns, pragmatiques et fondés sur le risque sur les relations avec les clients potentiels et existants.

• Effectuer des évaluations de la conformité fiscale, y compris les exigences de la FATCA, du CS Ex et de l'intermédiaire qualifié (QI).

• Effectuer des examens périodiques des relations avec les clients, en particulier les institutions financières et les partenaires externes.

• Effectuer des activités de surveillance des transactions pour un portefeuille désigné de clients des institutions financières.

• Participer à des réunions avec des clients potentiels et existants où la gestion des risques opérationnels est nécessaire.

• Collaborer avec les ventes, la conformité et d'autres intervenants internes afin de faciliter l'embarquement efficace tout en maintenant des normes de risque appropriées.

• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus d'embarquement, des contrôles des risques et des procédures internes.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking a Software Engineer who is passionate about delivering high-quality software. If you see yourself as a Craftsman who enjoys designing, brainstorming, reviewing and testing, then this is the right place for you!
As a Software Engineer on the Platforms Security team, you will develop and maintain software systems focused on Web and Mobile Authentication mecanisms, 2fa and third party integration. Security is at the heart of what we do — you will contribute to building secure, resilient systems that protect user identities, enforce access controls, and uphold the highest standards of data integrity. You will interact with product owners, designers, IT and other software engineers to deliver reliable and high-quality platform solutions.
What will you do here?

• Actively participate in the development of our security scope by creating efficient and reliable code

• Collaborate closely with product owners and designers to understand requirements, discuss solutions and translate their needs into robust implementations

• Keep yourself up-to-date on cutting-edge technologies — including AI-powered development tools and practices — and actively contribute to the technical direction of the team

• Explore and integrate AI capabilities where relevant to improve platform services, developer productivity or user experience

• Contribute to the design and implementation of secure systems ensuring compliance with KYC regulations and security best practices

• Coordinate and organize product evolution and delivery

• Provide support on the applications to our internal and external users

• Use modern test frameworks to ensure the quality of the applications

• A degree in computer science or equivalent

• Min 5 years of experience in development of production-ready applications

• Experience in Java development and willingness to learn open source frameworks such as Maven, Spring and Hibernate

• Knowledge of RESTful services

• Knowledge of Linux, Docker, Jenkins, Tomcat, Kubernetes, Sonar and Databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Redis)

• Knowledge of Git version control system

• Familiar or willing to work with Kibana and Grafana

• Knowledge of event-driven architectures

• Familiar or willing to work with test-driven development: TestNG, Wiremock, etc.

• Solid analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Experience working in Agile environments

• Good communication skills, team player, rigorous and autonomous

• Familiarity with security standards and protocols (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, PKI, etc.) is a plus

• Fluent in English, French is an asset

• Experience with React or frontend development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript) is a plus

descriptionByLocale.en:
As an AI Enablement Engineer, you will be responsible for accelerating AI adoption across the Technology department while helping the wider organization identify and implement high-impact AI initiatives.
Reporting directly to the Head Talent & Methodology, you will work closely with Engineering Managers, the Tech Drive (Technical Governance), Communities of Practice, Methodology, Human Resources, Product Strategy, Operational Products, and other business departments.
Your mission is simple:
Make AI a core engineering capability at Swissquote.
You will continuously identify opportunities where AI can improve engineering excellence, operational efficiency, and product innovation, while ensuring adoption follows Swissquote's governance and quality standards.
Rather than only delivering training, you will build a sustainable enablement ecosystem that allows teams to become autonomous AI practitioners.
Key Responsibilities
AI Enablement & Learning

• Design, build and continuously evolve the Software Engineering AI Enablement Program.

• Deliver hands-on workshops, technical trainings, bootcamps and office hours.

• Coordinate AI learning initiatives across Software Engineering and Technology.

• Develop practical learning paths covering Generative AI, AI-assisted software development, prompting, AI agents, automation and emerging AI capabilities.

• Create reusable playbooks, best practices and engineering guidelines.

• Measure AI adoption and continuously improve enablement programs through feedback and metrics.
Partnership Engineering Excellence

• Work alongside engineering teams to identify opportunities where AI can significantly improve software development lifecycle productivity.

• Help teams integrate AI into software design, coding, testing, documentation, operations and maintenance.

• Prototype AI-powered engineering workflows and reference implementations.

• Actively collaborate with internal Communities of Practice and CoP Manager

• Organize technical talks, demos, hackathons and AI events

• Encourage experimentation while promoting responsible AI usage.
Working together with the Tech Drive organization, you will:

• Contribute to Software Engineering AI standards and best practices.

• Participate in defining AI governance for engineering activities.

• Ensure AI usage aligns with security, compliance and regulatory requirements.

• Identify recurring engineering challenges and propose AI-driven improvements.
Business Enablement
Beyond engineering, you will collaborate with Operational Products, Product Strategy, HR and business stakeholders to:

• Identify high-value AI opportunities.

• Facilitate AI discovery workshops in collaboration with the Methodology Team

• Prototype business solutions using Generative AI.

• Support departments during AI adoption and change management.

• Act as a trusted advisor on AI opportunities and implementation approaches.
Additional responsibilities - Innovation & External Representation
As one of Swissquote's AI ambassadors, you will:

• Monitor AI trends, technologies and industry best practices.

• Evaluate emerging AI tools and frameworks.

• Represent Software Engineering internally across Swissquote.

• Contribute to Swissquote's visibility externally through conferences, meetups, articles or technical communities when appropriate.

Required Qualifications

• 2-5 years of experience in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Developer Experience or Technical Consulting.

• Strong software engineering background with experience building production systems.

• Practical experience using Claude or similar LLMs in your own work: prompt engineering, using AI coding assistants, building small internal tools or scripts that leverage LLM APIs

• Demonstrated experience leading technical enablement, mentoring or training engineers.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong understanding of software engineering best practices.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong bias toward execution and continuous improvement.

• Passion for learning, experimentation and knowledge sharing.

• Curiosity about AI governance, security and cost management, and willingness to learn Swissquote’s specific constraints and policies
Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Claude Code, OpenWebUI or similar AI development environments.

• Exposure to spec-as-source, agentic workflows, or RAG patterns, even in small side projects

• Prior experience running brown-bag sessions, workshops, or internal documentation initiatives.

• Familiarity with Claude, OpenAI, OpenWebUI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar AI platforms.

• Experience with RAG, AI Agents, MCP, orchestration frameworks or agentic workflows.

• Knowledge of AI governance, security and regulatory requirements.

• Experience working in regulated environments.

• Public speaking experience, conference presentations or technical content creation is a strong plus.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione del Dipartimento - Piattaforme di Ingegneria del Software Il reparto Piattaforme di Ingegneria Software è dedicato al viaggio del cliente in Swissquote. Definiamo, analizziamo e realizziamo il futuro delle soluzioni di cliente offerte da Swissquote. Manteniamo anche quelle applicazioni per garantire sempre la migliore esperienza del cliente nel suo viaggio. Collaborando a stretto contatto con il reparto strategia di prodotto siamo anche il ponte tra la strategia di crescita dell’azienda e le soluzioni corrispondenti messe in atto, essendo poi i protagonisti che danno vita concreta alla visione definita. Lavorando fianco a fianco con i dipartimenti interni e il business che essi rappresentano ci assicuriamo di muoversi sempre verso i clienti e le esigenze degli stakeholder. Missione La sezione Istituzionale e Wealth progetta, sviluppa e mantiene piattaforme di investimento passive su Web e mobile per i clienti retail (InvestEasy, 3a easy, Save Easy, and more to come) così come l'intera serie di soluzioni per i clienti istituzionali (piattaforma API, SQPro, ponti con piattaforme esterne FX...) Sarete parte del team Istituzionale e Wealth Conception , lavorando insieme con altri 3 proprietari di prodotti, un product designer e un analista di business offshore. La missione del team è di trasformare la strategia aziendale in soluzioni possibili e guidare l'evoluzione del prodotto insieme ai team di ingegneria del software. Il vostro team si sta concentrando su tutti gli aspetti relativi al business istituzionale e alla gestione della ricchezza in tutte le linee aziendali (Forex, titoli, crypto). Le tue responsabilità:
• Comunicare e gestire le relazioni con gli stakeholder per fornire il miglior prodotto
• Definire e documentare i requisiti aziendali per catturare le esigenze e i vincoli aziendali e guidare il processo di sviluppo
• Definire e mantenere una roadmap del prodotto per fornire una chiara direzione per i team di sviluppo e le parti interessate
• Priorizzare il backlog del prodotto per garantire che il lavoro più prezioso sia affrontato prima e massimizzare ROI
• Analizzare e privilegiare il feedback dei clienti per la guida di miglioramenti continui e soddisfare le aspettative degli utenti
• Collabora con i progettisti per ottimizzare l'esperienza utente (ad esempio test A/B, mobile & web)
• Atto come esperto di materia per il prodotto, sostenere i team di business e sviluppo attraverso la condivisione della conoscenza e il mentoring
• Mantenere la consapevolezza delle tendenze del mercato e dell'industria per una migliore ottimizzazione della definizione delle soluzioni
• Fornire indicazioni sulla visione al Team di Sviluppo e spiegare i requisiti
• Creare e mantenere una documentazione completa per i riferimenti delle funzionalità aziendali
• Monitorare i KPI per eseguire la priorità delle funzionalità e migliorare le decisioni basate sui dati
• Assicurare la validazione incrementale del business per assicurarsi che le funzionalità sviluppate soddisfino i requisiti aziendali
• Sfondo educativo: Master o Bachelor
• Hai una profonda comprensione del trading di titoli, forex trading a plus
• Hai diversi anni di esperienza come proprietario del prodotto, analista di affari o un ruolo simile
• Hai diversi anni di esperienza di lavoro con team di sviluppo software agile, e una buona comprensione dello sviluppo del prodotto in un ambiente agile disciplinato
• Hai esperienza di lavorare a stretto contatto con i designer di prodotti per costruire soluzioni client finali su piattaforme web, mobile a plus
• Hai una comprensione approfondita dell'aspetto della qualità del prodotto, con esperienza preventiva di pianificazione e coordinamento delle attività di validazione aziendale
• Sei un eccellente comunicatore e storyteller con diversi stakeholder, in grado di affrontare le parti interessate e clienti istituzionali
• Hai esperienza nella condivisione delle tue conoscenze aziendali e nella mentoring di altri membri del team
• Fluente in inglese
descriptionByLocale.en:
Department Mission - Software Engineering Platforms
The Software Engineering Platforms department is dedicated to the customer's journey in Swissquote. We define, analyze and make alive the future of client facing solutions offered by Swissquote. We also maintain those applications to always ensure the best client experience in his journey.
By collaborating closely with product strategy department we also are the bridge between company’s growth strategy and the corresponding solutions put in place, being then the core actors giving concrete life to the vision defined.
By working hand in hand with the internal departments and the business that they represent we ensure to always move towards clients and stakeholders needs.

Team Mission
The Institutional and Wealth section designs, develops and maintains passive investment platforms on Web and mobile for retail clients (InvestEasy, 3a easy, Save Easy, and more to come) as well as the whole set of solutions for institutional clients (APIs, SQPro platform, bridges with FX external platforms…)
You will be part of Institutional and Wealth Conception team , working together with 3 other product owners, a product designer and an offshore business analyst.

The mission of the team is to transform company strategy into feasible solutions and drive the product's evolution together with the software engineering teams. Your team is focusing on all aspects related to Institutional business and Wealth management across all business lines (Forex, securities, crypto).
Your responsibilities:

• Communicate and manage relationships with stakeholders to deliver the best product

• Define and document business requirements to capture business needs and constraints, and guide the development process

• Define and maintain a product roadmap to provide a clear direction to the Development teams and stakeholders

• Prioritize the product backlog to ensure that the most valuable work is addressed first and maximize ROI

• Analyze and prioritize client feedback for driving continuous improvements and meeting user expectations

• Collaborate with designers to optimize the user experience (e.g A/B testing, mobile & web)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert for the product, support business and development teams by knowledge sharing and mentoring

• Maintain awareness of market and industry trends for better optimization of solution definition

• Provide guidance on the vision to the Development Team and explain requirements

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for business feature references

• Monitor KPIs to perform feature prioritization and enhance data-driven decisions

• Ensure incremental business validation to make sure developed features meet business requirements

• Educational background: Master or Bachelor degree

• You have a deep understanding of securities trading, forex trading a plus

• You have several years of experience as product owner, business analyst or a similar role

• You have several years of experience working with agile software development teams, and a good understanding of product development in a disciplined agile environment

• You have experience working closely with product designers to build end client solutions on web platforms, mobile a plus

Für den Teil Brand Management:

• Unterstützung bei der Koordination von Projekten über Abteilungen hinweg und Gewährleistung von Ausrichtung und Konsistenz im Brand Messaging.

• Führen Sie eine eingehende Wettbewerbs- und Marktanalyse durch, um Trends, Chancen und strategische Erkenntnisse zu identifizieren.

• Ausgezeichnetes Kommando von PowerPoint und Excel.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que stagiaire en marketing de marque, vous serez pleinement immergé dans l'environnement dynamique d'une équipe de marque au sein du secteur financier. En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de gestion des médias sociaux et de la marque, vous contribuerez au développement d'initiatives de marketing efficaces tout en acquérant une expérience pratique dans l'engagement des clients, la coordination des campagnes et l'analyse stratégique. Ce stage offre une occasion unique d'affiner votre créativité, votre réflexion analytique et vos compétences en gestion de projet dans un cadre international et accéléré.
Dans ce rôle, vous :
Pour la partie médias sociaux:

• Gérer les campagnes de marketing d'influence tout au long du stage : développer des concepts, identifier des influenceurs, coordonner des activations et superviser des projets de promotion de produits et de services.

• Gérer la communauté des médias sociaux Swissquote : répondre aux commentaires et aux messages, interagir avec la communauté et s'engager de manière proactive chaque jour.

• Aider les gestionnaires de médias sociaux à publier du contenu par le biais de la plateforme de gestion dédiée.

• Créez du contenu avec Canva et CapCut pour soutenir les responsables des médias sociaux dans leur travail quotidien.

• Effectuer des analyses comparatives sur les médias sociaux et surveiller les tendances, les formats et les pratiques exemplaires.

• Participez à la création vidéo verticale, avec la possibilité d'apparaître dans certaines vidéos.
Pour la partie Gestion de la marque:

• Coordonner et gérer le produit et le segment du point d'entrée (y compris, sans s'y limiter, Themes Trading et le public cible des étudiants), en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs des entreprises et des marques.

• Aider à coordonner les projets entre les ministères, en assurant l'harmonisation et l'uniformité des messages de marque.

• Contribuer à des séances de remue-méninges créatives, aidant à générer des idées novatrices pour les initiatives de marque et les activations des clients.

• Jouer un rôle actif dans l'amélioration de la satisfaction de la clientèle en appuyant le règlement rapide et efficace des demandes de renseignements de la clientèle, particulièrement pendant les campagnes et les périodes de promotion.

• Effectuer une analyse approfondie de la concurrence et du marché afin de déterminer les tendances, les possibilités et les perspectives stratégiques.

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des bureaux internationaux pour appuyer l'exécution transparente des activités de marketing.

• Surveiller et gérer la boîte de réception principale du département, en assurant des réponses rapides, professionnelles et alignées sur la marque.

• Langue maternelle française; forte maîtrise de l'anglais requise (l'italien et/ou l'allemand sont un plus).

• Poursuivant ou ayant obtenu récemment un diplôme universitaire en marketing (HEC, HES, ou équivalent). Expérience de stage antérieure en marketing est un plus.

• Fort intérêt pour le marketing en ligne et hors ligne, avec une curiosité pour la stratégie de marque.

• L'intérêt dans le secteur bancaire/finance est un avantage.

• Excellente commande de PowerPoint et Excel.

• Familiarisation avec les systèmes CRM et les outils d'analyse web est un plus.

• Créatif, proactif et capable de travailler indépendamment.

• Fortes compétences analytiques et organisationnelles, avec la capacité de synthétiser efficacement l'information.

• Excellentes compétences en communication, axées sur les détails et désireuses de prendre des initiatives.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come analista di Insights nel dipartimento di strategia del prodotto, avrete una grande opportunità di fornire l'autorità di analisi ai diversi stakeholder interni e team di gestione. Porterai le relative analisi, raccomandazioni e intuizioni attuabili per modellare il processo decisionale, sostenere progetti e obiettivi, iniziative strategiche e decision-making.
La vostra missione:

• Raccogliere, interpretare e presentare i dati per informare meglio le decisioni aziendali.

• Partecipa al successo e alla visione del prodotto aiutando con la ricerca, i dati, i report e le informazioni necessarie.

• Sostegno con approfondimenti la pianificazione strategica e l'ideazione, così come i progetti chiave della roadmap e le principali iniziative di progetto.

• Proprietà Dashboard: sviluppare dashboard di prodotto, mantenerli, e eseguire miglioramenti e modifiche necessarie.

• Preparare la ricerca e i report per la gestione del prodotto e i team che comunicano efficacemente conclusioni e modelli utilizzando i dati pertinenti.

• Comunicare rapporti e risultati dell'analisi dei dati al dipartimento, nonché i principali stakeholder di diversi dipartimenti della Banca.

• I risultati attuali e le raccomandazioni strategiche per la leadership esecutivo, fornendo chiare narrazioni supportate da dati forti.

• Assicurare qualità, convalida e documentazione di report.

• Contribuisci alla continua evoluzione delle migliori pratiche e strumenti analitici all'interno del team.

• Assistere la gestione del prodotto come necessario in qualsiasi fase di Insights attività di dati e di ricerca o esigenze.

• Collabora con team interfunzionali per sostenere iniziative che richiedono competenze analitiche profonde.

• Corso di laurea (analisi dati, business, economia).

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza lavorativa rilevante in Business Analytics e/o Reporting, preferibilmente nei servizi finanziari o negli ambienti tecnologici.

• Competenze ed esperienza nella creazione di dashboard con software Tableau e competenze SQL. Python è un vantaggio.

• Competenze eccellenti nei fogli di calcolo di Excel e la creazione di presentazioni in PowerPoint.

• Forte alfabetizzazione dei dati: capacità di manipolare, interpretare e sintetizzare set di dati complessi con alta precisione e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Mindset analitico, abilità numeriche e pensiero critico eccellente.

• Forte acume aziendale e pensiero strategico; capace di collegare intuizioni di dati ai risultati aziendali.

• Esperienza comprovata che influenza gli stakeholder e lavora con leadership senior per guidare decisioni strategiche.

• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali.

• Capacità di gestire più priorità, operare autonomamente, e soddisfare scadenze strette in un ambiente frenetico.

• Mindset collaborativo, orientamento del cliente e dedizione al miglioramento continuo e all'apprendimento.

• Fluente in inglese e francese, il tedesco è un plus.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As an Insights analyst in the Product Strategy department, you will have a great opportunity to provide empowering analytics to the different internal stakeholders and Management team. You will bring the relevant analysis, recommendations, and actionable insights to shape data-driven decision making, support projects and goals, strategic initiatives, and decision-making.
Your mission:

• Collect, interpret, and present the data to inform better business decisions.

• Participate in product success and vision by assisting with necessary research, data, reports, and insights.

• Support with insights the strategic planning and ideation, as well as key projects of the roadmap and the main project initiatives.

• Dashboard ownership: develop product dashboards, maintain them, and perform necessary improvements and modifications.

• Prepare research and reports for the Product management and teams that effectively communicate conclusions and patterns using relevant data.

• Communicate reports and results of data analysis to the department, as well as the main stakeholders from different departments of the Bank.

• Present findings and strategic recommendations to Executive leadership, delivering clear narratives supported by strong data.

• Ensure quality, validation, and documentation of reporting.

• Contribute to the continuous evolution of analytical best practices and tools within the team.

• Assist Product management as necessary at any phase of Insights data and research activities or needs.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support initiatives requiring deep analytical expertise.

• Bachelor’s degree (Data analytics, Business, Economics).

• At least 3 years of relevant work experience in Business Analytics and/or Reporting, preferably in financial services or technology environments.

• Skills and experience in creating dashboards with Tableau software and SQL skills. Python is a plus.

• Excellent skills in Excel spreadsheets and creating presentations in PowerPoint.

• Strong data literacy: ability to manipulate, interpret, and synthesize complex datasets with high accuracy and attention to detail.

• Analytical mindset, numerical skills, and excellent critical thinking.

• Strong business acumen and strategic thinking; capable of connecting data insights to business outcomes.

• Proven experience influencing stakeholders and working with senior leadership to drive strategic decisions.

• Very good written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, operate autonomously, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative mindset, customer-first orientation, and dedication to continuous improvement and learning.

• Fluent in English and French, German is a plus.

• Kollaborative Denkweise, Kundenorientierung und Engagement für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Lernen.

• digitalizzazione dei documenti — Preparare, scansionare e eseguire controlli di qualità sui documenti in arrivo.
• Indicizzazione strutturata — Assegna metadati accurati per garantire il recupero rapido e affidabile.
• Classificazione dei documenti — Organizzare i record digitali e fisici secondo gli standard interni.
• Controllo della qualità — Verificare accuratezza, leggibilità e coerenza dei file digitalizzati.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Records Management Agent within our Campus Services department, you will play a key role in the digital transformation of our internal processes. You will be responsible for the digitization, indexing, and classification of physical and electronic documents to ensure their accessibility, compliance, and long-term preservation.
This position is ideal for someone detail oriented, organized, and motivated by continuous improvement in document workflows.
Your responsibilities:

• Document digitization — Prepare, scan, and perform quality checks on incoming documents.

• Structured indexing — Assign accurate metadata to ensure fast and reliable retrieval.

• Document classification — Organize digital and physical records according to internal standards.

• Quality control — Verify accuracy, readability, and consistency of digitized files.

• Document workflow management — Contribute to optimizing archiving and information flow processes.

• Internal support — Assist teams with document searches, retrieval, and consultation.

• “Agente en information documentaire CFC / Agent en information documentaire CFC” or equivalent

• At least 2 years of experience in this function or similar

• Comfortable with scanning tools, document management systems and digital environments.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and strict adherence to procedures.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple departments.

• Proficiency in French and English
descriptionByLocale.de:

• Komfortabel mit Scan-Tools, Dokumentenmanagementsystemen und digitalen Umgebungen.

responsabilità

After an initial training period covering our banking and trading platforms, Oracle databases, internal Python-based tools, and financial products, you will join our Application & Business Support team and play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation of Swissquote's production systems.
Your mission will be to investigate complex business and technical issues, support critical banking and trading operations, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our internal processes and tools.
Responsibilities

• Investigate and resolve complex incidents impacting our banking, trading and forex platforms.

• Act as a primary point of contact for internal departments requiring technical and business support.

• Perform root cause analysis on production issues and coordinate with development teams when escalations are required.

• Analyze large datasets and conduct investigations using SQL (Oracle, Postgres).

• Maintain and improve monitoring processes to ensure the reliability of our systems and services.

• Develop automation tools and scripts (Python) to increase operational efficiency and reduce manual workload.

• Produce complex data extractions and analyses for business, legal, compliance, and operational teams.

• Participate in internal reconciliations and database integrity controls to ensure data consistency across platforms.

• Monitor critical production processes and proactively identify anomalies.

• Contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for business-critical applications.

• Be open to joining an on-call rotation to provide 24/7 support in the long term.

• Degree in Information Systems (for example Bachelor HES or similar) and a strong interest for IT

• Your skills set include the following: Windows/Unix/Linux environment, SQL and scripting (Python, Bash), Git.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Eager to work on critical systems.

• Interest in financial markets, banking operations, and trading systems.

• Ability to understand both technical systems and business processes.

• Strong communication skills and ability to interact with multiple stakeholders.

• Autonomous, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.

• Good knowledge of French and strong working knowledge of English (minimum B2)

SQ2
descriptionByLocale.de:

• Interesse an Finanzmärkten, Bankgeschäften und Handelssystemen.

• Fähigkeit, sowohl technische Systeme als auch Geschäftsprozesse zu verstehen.

• Contribuer aux initiatives de documentation, de partage des connaissances et d'amélioration continue.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di Senior Information Security Engineer, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella costruzione della sicurezza e della privacy attraverso la progettazione nei nostri sistemi e prodotti di informazione. Nell'ambito del Servizio di Sicurezza Informatica, collaborerai con i nostri Dipartimenti di Ingegneria Informatica e Software per progettare, rivedere e controllare le misure di sicurezza in una vasta gamma di prodotti e tecnologie, e contribuirai a automatizzare i processi e le attività di sicurezza. Sarete responsabili di identificare e analizzare nuovi rischi e vulnerabilità, e di progettare una riparazione efficace per migliorare la nostra postura di sicurezza. Contribuirai anche alla formazione di sicurezza degli ingegneri software, promuovendo una cultura della coscienza di sicurezza tra dipendenti e stakeholder. Insieme agli altri membri del team IT Security, contribuirai a rendere la nostra Banca più sicura e resiliente e a crescere in modo efficiente in un settore sempre più regolamentato. Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista esperto di sicurezza dell'informazione che può sfruttare la loro esperienza e prosperare in un ambiente dinamico e veloce. Se siete desiderosi di abbracciare questa sfida, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione.
• Fornire consulenza e linee guida di sicurezza ai team di ingegneria del software per elaborare, far rispettare e monitorare i controlli e le soluzioni di sicurezza.
• Eseguire la valutazione dei rischi di nuovi progetti e team di supporto nell'applicazione di misure di mitigazione.
• Progettare architetture sicure ed eseguire la modellazione delle minacce.
• Contribuire all'automazione della sicurezza (SOAR, attività di scripting ricorrenti).
• Recensione e migliorare la nostra sicurezza SDLC basata su strumenti e standard noti (PCI SSD, OWASP, OpenSAMM)
• Contribuisci a elaborare report di sicurezza e dashboard.
• Coordinare con i fornitori di test di sicurezza e i team interni per i test di penetrazione e i rapporti di vulnerabilità.
• Partecipa alle nostre attività interne del Red Team.
• Consigliare soluzioni tecniche relative ai servizi di custodia cripto e partecipare alla loro elaborazione.
• Partecipare a due processi di diligenza durante l'installazione di un partner o di una soluzione tecnica.
• Operare e mantenere HSM e soluzioni di custodia cripto.
• Partecipa alle attività di risposta agli incidenti di sicurezza. Mandato
• Esperienza minima di 5 anni come Ingegnere di Sicurezza, Architetto o ruoli simili
• Capacità di comunicare e interagire con vari dipartimenti e team
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione francese e inglese, orale e scritta
• Buon comando di scripting e linguaggi di programmazione (Python, PowerShell, Java)
• Conoscenza di tecnologie e concetti come SIEM, EDR, SOAR, Cloud, Networking, Windows, Linux
• Solida capacità di pensiero analitico e critico Desiderato
• Bachelor o Master in Informatica o simili
• Esperienza con Kubernetes e Microsoft Azure
• Esperienza con: Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic / Kibana, OpenCTI, Java S Q2
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Senior information Security Engineer, you will play a key role in building security and privacy by design in our information systems and products.
As part of the Information Security Service, you will collaborate with our IT and Software Engineering Departments to design, review and audit security measures across a wide range of products and technologies, and you will contribute to automating security processes and activities. You will be responsible to identify and analyze new risks and vulnerabilities, and to design effective remediation to improve our security posture. You will also contribute to the software engineers security training, fostering a culture of security consciousness among employees and stakeholders.
Together with the other members of the IT Security team, you will contribute to make our Bank more secure and resilient, and to grow efficiently in an increasingly regulated industry.
We are looking for a seasoned Information Security professional who can leverage their expertise and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. If you are eager to embrace this challenge, we look forward to receiving your application.

• Provide security advisory and guidelines to software engineering teams to elaborate, enforce and monitor security controls and solutions.

• Perform risk assessments of new projects and support teams in applying mitigation measures.

• Design secure architectures and perform threat modelling.

• Contribute to security automation (SOAR, scripting recurring tasks).

• Review and improve our SDLC security based on known tools and standards (PCI SSD, OWASP, OpenSAMM)

• Contribute to elaborating security reports and dashboards.

• Coordinate with security testing providers and internal teams for penetration tests and vulnerability reports.

• Participate to our internal Red Team activities.

• Advise on technical solutions related to crypto custody services and participate in their elaboration.

• Participate in due diligence process when onboarding a partner or technical solution.

• Operate and maintain HSMs and crypto custody solutions.

• Participate to security incident response activities.

Mandatory

• Minimum 5 years experience as Security Engineer, Architect or similar roles

• Ability to communicate and engage with various departments and teams

• Excellent French and English communication skills, oral and written

• Good command of scripting and programming languages (Python, PowerShell, Java)

• Knowledge of technologies and concepts such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, Cloud, Networking, Windows, Linux

• Solid analytical and critical thinking abilities
Desired

• Bachelor or Master in Computer Science or similar

• Experience with Kubernetes and Microsoft Azure

• Experience with: Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic / Kibana, OpenCTI, Java

S​​​​​​Q2
descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Senior Information Security Engineer spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle beim Aufbau von Sicherheit und Datenschutz durch Design in unseren Informationssystemen und -produkten. Im Rahmen des Informationssicherheitsdienstes arbeiten Sie mit unseren IT- und Software-Engineering-Abteilungen zusammen, um Sicherheitsmaßnahmen für eine Vielzahl von Produkten und Technologien zu entwerfen, zu überprüfen und zu prüfen, und tragen zur Automatisierung von Sicherheitsprozessen und -aktivitäten bei. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, neue Risiken und Schwachstellen zu identifizieren und zu analysieren und wirksame Abhilfemaßnahmen zu entwickeln, um unsere Sicherheitslage zu verbessern. Sie werden auch zur Sicherheitsschulung für Softwareingenieure beitragen und eine Kultur des Sicherheitsbewusstseins bei Mitarbeitern und Stakeholdern fördern. Gemeinsam mit den anderen Mitgliedern des IT-Sicherheitsteams werden Sie dazu beitragen, unsere Bank sicherer und widerstandsfähiger zu machen und in einer zunehmend regulierten Branche effizient zu wachsen. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Informationssicherheitsexperten, der sein Fachwissen nutzen und in einer dynamischen, schnelllebigen Umgebung gedeihen kann. Wenn Sie diese Herausforderung annehmen möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.
• Bereitstellung von Sicherheitsempfehlungen und Richtlinien für Software-Engineering-Teams zur Ausarbeitung, Durchsetzung und Überwachung von Sicherheitskontrollen und -lösungen.
• Führen Sie Risikobewertungen neuer Projekte durch und unterstützen Sie Teams bei der Anwendung von Minderungsmaßnahmen.
• Entwerfen Sie sichere Architekturen und führen Sie Bedrohungsmodelle durch.
• Tragen Sie zur Sicherheitsautomatisierung bei (SOAR, Scripting Repeating Tasks).
• Überprüfung und Verbesserung unserer SDLC-Sicherheit basierend auf bekannten Tools und Standards (PCI SSD, OWASP, OpenSAMM)
• Tragen Sie zur Ausarbeitung von Sicherheitsberichten und Dashboards bei.
• Koordination mit Anbietern von Sicherheitstests und internen Teams für Penetrationstests und Schwachstellenberichte.

• Beratung zu technischen Lösungen im Zusammenhang mit Krypto-Verwahrungsdiensten und Teilnahme an deren Ausarbeitung.

Dans le cadre du Service de la sécurité de l'information, vous collaborerez avec nos départements de l'informatique et du génie logiciel à la conception, à l'examen et à l'audit de mesures de sécurité sur une vaste gamme de produits et de technologies, et vous contribuerez à l'automatisation des processus et des activités de sécurité. Vous serez responsable d'identifier et d'analyser les nouveaux risques et vulnérabilités, et de concevoir des mesures correctives efficaces pour améliorer notre posture de sécurité. Vous contribuerez également à la formation des ingénieurs logiciels en matière de sécurité, en favorisant une culture de conscience de la sécurité parmi les employés et les intervenants. En collaboration avec les autres membres de l'équipe de la sécurité informatique, vous contribuerez à rendre notre banque plus sûre et plus résistante et à se développer efficacement dans une industrie de plus en plus réglementée. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un professionnel chevronné de la sécurité de l'information qui peut exploiter son expertise et prospérer dans un environnement dynamique et rapide. Si vous êtes désireux de relever ce défi, nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature.
• Fournir des conseils et des directives en matière de sécurité aux équipes de génie logiciel pour élaborer, faire appliquer et surveiller les contrôles et les solutions de sécurité.
• Effectuer des évaluations des risques des nouveaux projets et des équipes de soutien dans l'application des mesures d'atténuation.

• Contribuer à l'automatisation de la sécurité (SOAR, scripting des tâches récurrentes).

Stellenbeschreibung Sie werden in die Abteilung Back Office integriert und direkt an das Settlement Retail Team angehängt:

• Tägliche Nutzung von SWIFT Nachrichten MT54*/MT76*/MT599
• Nutzung von Telekurs, Bloomberg, GTMatch, GTExchange, T24, externen Portalen und internen Tools

• Fließend Französisch, Sie haben auch gute Englischkenntnisse; Deutsch wäre ein Plus
• Sie beherrschen das Office Pack (Microsoft Excel / Microsoft Word) und sind generell an technischen Tools interessiert
• Sie sind stressresistent und haben eine gute Lernfähigkeit
• Als Teamplayer möchten Sie einem dynamischen Team beitreten SQ1

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Python, PHP, PostgreSQL Sviluppatore sarà responsabile per la progettazione, lo sviluppo e la manutenzione delle nostre applicazioni e sistemi bancari. Il candidato ideale avrà un forte background in queste tecnologie e un forte interesse per le operazioni bancarie. Responsabilità:
• Sviluppare, testare e mantenere applicazioni software di alta qualità utilizzando Python, PHP e PostgreSQL.
• Collabora con team interfunzionali per definire, progettare e spedire nuove funzionalità.
• Assicurare le prestazioni, la qualità e la reattività delle applicazioni.
• Identificare e correggere i colli di bottiglia e correggere gli insetti.
• Aiuta a mantenere la qualità del codice, l'organizzazione e l'automatizzazione.
• Partecipa alle recensioni dei codici e fornisce un feedback costruttivo ai membri del team.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli analisti e gli stakeholder aziendali per raccogliere i requisiti e tradurli in specifiche tecniche.
• Resta aggiornato con le ultime tendenze e tecnologie del settore per garantire che le nostre applicazioni rimangano competitive e aggiornate.
• Corso di laurea in Informatica, Tecnologia dell'informazione, o campo relativo.
• 2-4 anni di esperienza professionale nello sviluppo del software.
• Proficienza in Python, PHP e PostgreSQL.
• Forte comprensione dei principi di sviluppo del software e delle API RESTful.
• Esperienza con sistemi di controllo della versione come GitHub.
• La familiarità con le tecnologie di front-end (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) è un vantaggio.
• Eccellente capacità di problem solving e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e di lavoro di squadra.
• L'affinità per le operazioni bancarie e la comprensione dei sistemi finanziari è altamente auspicabile. SQ2
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Python, PHP, PostgreSQL Developer will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of our banking applications and systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in these technologies and a keen interest in banking operations. Responsibilities:
• Develop, test, and maintain high-quality software applications using Python, PHP, and PostgreSQL.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
• Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
• Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs.
• Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization.
• Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
• Work closely with business analysts and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
• Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to ensure our applications remain competitive and up-to-date.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
• 2-4 years of professional experience in software development.
• Proficiency in Python, PHP, and PostgreSQL.
• Strong understanding of software development principles and RESTful APIs.
• Experience with version control systems such as GitHub.
• Familiarity with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a plus.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
• Affinity for banking operations and understanding of financial systems is highly desirable.   SQ2
